---
title: "Drafts awaiting review"
description: "Case studies written but not yet published."
search: false
include-in-header:
  text: |
    <meta name="robots" content="noindex, nofollow">
---

Case studies that are written and waiting for review before they go live. A case appears here when
its `00_meta.yml` says `status: draft` and its `report.qmd` still says `draft: true`; it leaves the
list when it is published. The list is rebuilt with the site on every push and every scheduled
release. This page is not linked from the menu.

```{r}
#| label: drafts
#| results: asis
`%||%` <- function(a, b) if (is.null(a)) b else a
cases <- list.dirs("cases", recursive = FALSE)
cases <- cases[!startsWith(basename(cases), "_")]

# Front-matter flag in report.qmd: draft: true / false
is_draft <- function(dir) {
  qmd <- file.path(dir, "report.qmd")
  if (!file.exists(qmd)) return(FALSE)
  any(grepl("^draft:\\s*true\\b", readLines(qmd, warn = FALSE, encoding = "UTF-8")))
}

rows <- lapply(cases, function(dir) {
  meta_file <- file.path(dir, "00_meta.yml")
  if (!file.exists(meta_file)) return(NULL)
  meta <- yaml::read_yaml(meta_file, fileEncoding = "UTF-8")
  if (!identical(meta$status, "draft") || !is_draft(dir)) return(NULL)
  id <- basename(dir)
  when <- if (is.null(meta$publish_at)) "awaiting review" else paste("scheduled for", meta$publish_at)
  data.frame(issue = meta$issue %||% NA, id = id, title = meta$title %||% id,
             author = meta$author %||% "", when = when, stringsAsFactors = FALSE)
})
rows <- do.call(rbind, rows)

if (is.null(rows) || nrow(rows) == 0) {
  cat("*No drafts awaiting review.*\n")
} else {
  rows <- rows[order(rows$issue), ]
  cat('<table class="table">\n<thead><tr><th>Issue</th><th>Draft</th><th>Author</th>',
      '<th>Technical note</th><th>Status</th></tr></thead>\n<tbody>\n', sep = "")
  for (i in seq_len(nrow(rows))) {
    r <- rows[i, ]
    cat('<tr><td>', r$issue, '</td>',
        '<td><a href="/cases/', r$id, '/report.html">', r$title, '</a></td>',
        '<td>', r$author, '</td>',
        '<td><a href="/cases/', r$id, '/brief.pdf">PDF</a></td>',
        '<td>', r$when, '</td></tr>\n', sep = "")
  }
  cat('</tbody>\n</table>\n')
}
```
